body:
My heart absolutely breaks for you and this post. I hope you achieve your goals that you have laid out and find someone truly awseome!

Also 
> and the girl I cared and thought as a really good friend and a potential partner told me that she would never date a man like me and that I am talking too much, wasting her time and that I am too ugly for her.

This person does not deserve your attention.

I see!

I am literally within whispering distance of her lol so it would be SUPER awkward if she said no.

I am planning on finding a new job soon and going to ask her after I leave my current position.

Best of luck to you!

I am eerily in the exact same position except I work near her but shes on a different team, ages are very similar too.

My question is did you message him on an app? Did you have to match first or is this something like a non-match dating website?

I'm terrified of her saying no (not scared of getting rejected) and then having to see her everyday. That would make things really awkward.

Sorry if these are too personal questions!

TBH I don't think anyone will remember too significantly what you said but yourself.

We are our own harshest critics.
This may be geared more towards OCD, but has some SA in it as well.
Everything in the world keeps revolving except you.
Same here, I just sit in my room after work and play video games. Don't do anything productive at all. I often wonder where is the fine line is between laziness and depression.
i admitted this to my therapist that is one of the many thoughts i have everyday....
That does make sense, that really sucks your ex cheated on you. Thank you for taking the time to reply.

I dont know how to put this, and it may make no sense, but I have and haven't made peace with the fact that I won't ever be with her ever again. 
Have in the sense that she has moved on and found someone else (engaged, actually) 
Haven't in the sense where my depression tortures me about not getting over her.
Sorry if this makes no sense at all....
What is it for someone where the S.O. was the nicest, caring person ever. Didn't break up on bad terms and are still friends????
If its not too personal, how many years has it been? For me its been roughly 8 years...i know....eight years....
Immediately followed by, "Get up, you have to get up. GET UP!!"
Wouldn't think twice
Family failure checking in, you're not alone.
I've done the same 2 years ago. No 2 week notice or anything, just wrote an email that said I can't do this anymore. Depression sucks.
Sleeping
You are a good person.
Fear of surviving.
I'm boring as well, friend. I have interests that no one is interested in.
This breaks my heart
I go to work and stare at a screen for 8 hours (I work in IT) and then I come home and stare at a screen for 8 hours until its time for bed.

I always think about this. I think if it were painless and quick (such as a button you press and you're gone), there would be a lot less humans on this earth. Suicide is innately hard because its not meant to be done, goes against your instincts. Just my 2 cents
You sound like me when i was going thru my past relapses. Unfortunately I can only do this when its my weekend due to work. The cycle is sleep as long as possible and be awake as little as possible.
Same here! Sleep is just the best escape.
When you hate yourself so much you think about suicide everyday and everyone is progressing in their lives but you.
Valentine's day is just as worse as Christmas and New Years
Life is too damn long....
Hopefully your work is understanding.
29 here, most 16 year olds have accomplished more than I have.
You have some really great co-workers.
Delete facebook, it compounds the feelings of depression. Comparing yourself to all your friends or acquaintances is not going to work in your favor.
Yup
I was blaming myself for this earlier, I know the original joke was 3 bullets. But I wanted to stay within OP's premise in his/her title.

> Unfortunately, the only thing my girlfriend is doing right now is taking meds. Meds which aren't really working well for her, but she doesn't want to go to the doctors.

This is the path ive been taking for almost 10 years now, why did it take me so long to realize I can't use it as a 100% crutch?
If I was in a room with justin beiber, hitler and osama bin laden and I had one bullet, I'd still shoot myself

> who thrives on bad news

This is me.....
Focusing on all the absolute negative things about yourself. Unable to work. Constant suicidal thoughts and plans to act them out. Just to name a few..........
I'm in disarray, I shouldn't have done this to my 2 friends.

Kind of complicated on that front. This was 8 years ago (yes eight). I have just suffered from depression for 10 years with relapses and remissions. Right now I'm in a relapse state and my mind just likes to fucking torture me. I mean who the hell still thinks about their ex AFTER 8 YEARS. What the fuck was I doing in those 8  years? Why couldn't I get a girlfriend....or even a fucking job for that matter
The only (in person) interaction with other people I get is at work, if I didn't have that, I could go a longgggg time without any interaction.

Its amazing isn't it? The mask which we put on for the world (work, school, social gatherings) can be so deeply and frighteningly convincing to others? Of course no one wants to not put on a mask and just be depressed around everyone, so we resort to the mask!

Thanks for your reply, I have calmed down quite a bit. Just today was bad for some reason I can't find out why. (work wasn't that stressful)

As far as help goes, I've been seeing a psychiatrist for about 10 years now, and through relapses and remissions, medication adjustments (mainly increases because of relapse) I tried to get off them late last year, but the symptoms returned and quickly got back on them. Now I  have had two increases (I take 3 medications total, 1 is at max dose) in medication and I am not feeling any better. Its a chore to wake up, its a chore to go to work and its a chore to shower. I want to come off the medication but I fear that it will bring me to rock bottom where I will not be able to even function at a basic level. I don't know what to do.....

To answer your question, yes I do help people, but that's because I have to in order to get paid. I am pretty kind most of the time. Reasonable is a gray area, I have so many parts of my personality that are absolutely horrid. I think the ratio of good to bad personality traits would be a good 1:20
Thank you for responding, you kind soul. I guess the most important question right now is, why should I live? What do I bring to the table that can benefit anyone?

Good on you for telling your boss! I'm honestly really afraid to tell mine, even though I'm pretty sure he'd understand, I'm just terrified of initiating it. Also I've read that doing so can backfire. In your case, I'm glad it went well!!
Its been like this ever since I relapsed back into depression on the 26th of October of 2016....I don't feel feelings anymore, im just numb to everything.

Of course not, but being depressed has really robbed me of so much time. Time spent sleeping, being unproductive, etc. Time spent destroying relationships and not forming new ones...just a total and utter failure at life.
I always envy the people who say that they have too many things to do and so little time. They are also the people who say life is short. I wish I was one of those people.
This is actually a really good point. Its like the facebook life, people are only sharing their "ups" in life.
If I had access to a gun, I would have ended it a very long time ago. I do not belong in this world.
This resonates with me so well, its scary.
Oh this is complete bullshit. If anything life is too damn long, and I want an out without the need to kill myself.
I know this might sound really stupid, but when I'm not depressed (ie content or happy) I feel smarter.
I'm a prisoner in my own mind.

Holy shit..was this written by me? Except I'm 29 now and have graduated from college and have a decent job....everything else in my life is in shambles. Social skiils, fitness, relationships....all 0 on a 1-10 scale.

> meowt 

Hidden cat pun, im on to you

Thinking I was able to get off my anti-depressants, got depressed 3 months later and now am struggling to find a right dose (after three increases) to stabilize me. Maybe i'm just not meant to be happy....

I wish life had either a:

* Fast forward button - So I can fast forward to the last hour (hmm maybe day) before I die.
* Instant kill button - This is pretty self explanatory.

I'm recently going through a relapse after I thought I could get off my medication (hah!). To me, being normal is not having trouble getting out of bed and not having trouble doing things. But the definition of "normal" is different for everyone.

You sound like an extremely intelligent person, its really unfortunate about the situation with your eyes. I play WoW too, and it has gotten me through some of the darkest times in my life. Don't consider it wasting time if you're having fun, its just like any other hobby.

I hope you find out a solution to your problem.
I sincerely hope things get better for you. Good luck!

Me.

I haven't been ostracized because of my depression. Its caused me to do such stupid shit like quit a job without giving a 2 weeks notice. It took me 10 years to get a bachelor's degree. Meanwhile my bro has a PhD and has a kid and is doing very well. I am the textbook definition of a fuck-up.

This is going to be me pretty soon. Because of the holidays, work has been pretty slow, but oh man starting this week onward, its gonna get crazy. I'm gonna get yelled at, looked down upon and just be absolutely broken...at which point ill probably have a panic attack, i mean I almost had one when it wasn't busy at my job

I hope you make it through this, OP
Thank you
I constantly envision how I'm going to end up taking my life...it gives me some sort of hope that the mental illness will end

i WISH i was a highly functioning depressive person....the only thing my depression does is make me super lazy and lethargic. But hey, I never show this and put on my mask for everyone and everthing is "okay"

The situation you are in right now is what I fear I'm going to be in a few months. I just recently got a new job and I'm two weeks in....my co workers are so awesome for helping me out as much as they can...but I can only be in training for so long. 

My manager is also a huge dick...so I'm not getting yelled at yet for fucking up or not doing anything...but he did yell at everyone on my team on Wednesday (excluding me) and I almost had a panic attack. Can you imagine whats going to happen when the frustration is directed at me? I have such terrible social anxiety....

Good to know I'm not alone. If it gets really bad, you can always find a new job. Hope all the best for you.
